If you’re located near one of these offices, we would love for you to spend time in the office regularly. Some roles are hybrid or in-office by design. For example, our engineering team in India works primarily from our Gurugram office.

ROLE:

As a Quantitative Researcher at SentiLink, you will build our core products: models that identify fraudsters and also advance our growing suite of products in financial risk. This role is designed for new PhD graduates or early-career researchers interested in applying machine learning to real-world fraud detection. You'll build and ship machine learning models in a production environment, gaining hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle, from research and development to deployment at scale. If you're looking for real-world AI and ML exposure in an industry setting, not just research papers, this is it.

- Identity - resolves identities across massive, often conflicting data sources (both digital and physical) and generates risk models from limited information

You will be relied upon to be technically capable and the definitive owner of your respective domain. You should be interested in having end-to-end ownership and a fast-moving environment where deep domain understanding drives development and unusual insights drive our competitive advantage rather than optimization of new machine learning methodologies.

title: Implemention Specialist
description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios - empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries - and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations - and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works - join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About the role

We're looking for an Implementation Specialist to lead customers through successful software implementations. As our customer base grows across Europe and beyond, this role is critical to ensuring every customer starts with SINGU on the right foundations.

You'll own the implementation process from kick-off through go-live - understanding customer business processes, configuring the platform, migrating data, and making sure users are ready to adopt the system. It's a customer-facing role combining project coordination, technical problem-solving, and business consulting.

You'll work alongside Project Managers, Product, Customer Success, Support, and Engineering. It suits someone who enjoys ownership, thrives in a dynamic SaaS environment, and is comfortable running several implementations at once.

About the product

SINGU is a unified CAFM platform helping owners and operators of commercial real estate manage their buildings more efficiently. The platform supports facility management, maintenance, service delivery, inspections, and operational workflows from one central system.

SINGU supports the daily operations of more than 250 million m² of commercial real estate across 35+ countries, helping over 500,000 professionals manage more than 100,000 buildings worldwide.

Location

Hybrid - Kraków or Warsaw, with the flexibility a scale-up offers. Comfortable working with international customers.

What you'll be doing

- Own software implementations from kick-off through go-live

- Gather customer requirements and translate business needs into system configuration

- Configure SINGU modules based on the agreed scope and best practices

- Prepare, clean, validate, and import customer data, ensuring high data quality

- Support customers through testing, UAT, and go-live, resolving issues and coordinating internal teams

- Deliver training sessions and help users build confidence with the platform

- Identify risks, resolve blockers, and keep projects moving forward

- Work closely with Project Managers, Product, Customer Success, Support, and Engineering

- Improve implementation standards and repeatable processes that help the business scale

What you'll bring to the team

- 2-4 years in SaaS implementation, solution consulting, or technical project delivery

- Experience configuring software platforms based on customer requirements

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, especially with customer data

- Experience with data migration, Excel, imports, or system configuration

- Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical users

- Confidence managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously

- Comfort working independently in a fast-paced

description:

Location: Remote (LATAM, Pakistan, South Africa, Eastern Europe Preferred)
About the Role
Our client is seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer to design, configure, secure, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure across multiple environments.
This role requires deep technical expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, monitoring, and troubleshooting, along with a proactive mindset focused on uptime, security, scalability, and operational reliability. The Network Engineer will support both day-to-day network operations and long-term infrastructure initiatives while collaborating closely with cloud, DevOps, and IT teams.
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, calm under pressure, and capable of solving complex networking issues in fast-moving production environments.
Responsibilities
Network Configuration & Maintenance

• Configure and manage enterprise-grade routers, switches, and firewalls including Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, and Fortinet devices
• Implement and maintain VLANs, VPNs, QoS policies, and routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP
• Perform firmware upgrades, device patching, and hardware lifecycle management
• Configure network segmentation and redundancy to improve reliability and performance
• Support LAN, WAN, wireless, and hybrid cloud networking environments

Monitoring & Troubleshooting

• Monitor network performance and availability using SolarWinds, Nagios, PRTG, Zabbix, or similar platforms

• Respond to escalated incidents and provide detailed root cause analysis documentation

• Implement and maintain firewall policies, ACLs, VPN security, and intrusion prevention systems
• Support Zero Trust networking initiatives and secure segmentation strategies
• Ensure compliance with security and regulatory frameworks including PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOX, and GDPR where applicable
• Maintain patching schedules and monitor for vulnerabilities across network infrastructure

Performance Optimization & Reliability

• Conduct bandwidth analysis and capacity planning to support growth and performance
• Optimize load balancing, failover systems, and high-availability configurations
• Improve uptime, resiliency, and network scalability across environments
• Identify risks proactively and recommend infrastructure improvements before outages occur

Documentation & Governance

• Maintain accurate network diagrams, topology maps, runbooks, and operational documentation using Visio, Lucidchart, or similar tools
• Document network changes, incidents, and configurations following ITIL or change management best practices
• Ensure all network documentation remains audit-ready and current

Collaboration & Infrastructure Projects

• Participate in infrastructure planning and long-term network architecture discussions

• Strong troubleshooting instincts with the ability to stay calm under pressure
• Highly detail-oriented with strong documentation discipline
• Excellent communicator capable of explaining technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Proactive mindset focused on prevention, reliability, and continuous improvement
• Comfortable managing multiple priorities in fast-paced environments

title: Storage Server & Engineering, Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
We’re in an unbelievably exciting area of tech and are fundamentally reshaping the data storage industry. Here, you lead with innovative thinking, grow along with us, and join the smartest team in the industry.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for Hyperscale Operations, you will serve as the primary technical coordination lead for integrating Everpure’s Direct Flash Modules (DFMs) into next generation hyperscale storage platforms.  Working closely with hyperscale customers and ODM partners, Everpure’s hardware and firmware engineering, product engineering, quality, operations, you will drive the end-to-end technical execution required to ensure DFMs are seamlessly integrated into customer-designed storage servers and L10/L11 manufacturing. You will lead cross-functional program execution from architecture alignment and platform qualification through manufacturing ramp, driving issue resolution, root-cause analysis, and technical risk mitigation to deliver reliable, high-quality deployments that meet aggressive customer milestones.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Orchestrate Hardware NPI Execution: Lead cross-functional engineering teams through EVT, DVT, and PVT milestone gates for complex storage server and L10/L11 rack systems, delivering scalable, high-yielding hardware platforms to high-volume manufacturing.

• Orchestrate Technical Issue Resolution: Lead cross-functional triage across hardware, firmware, product engineering, and quality teams to drive root-cause analysis and resolve system-level qualification issues and platform bottlenecks.

• Accelerate Strategic Partner Performance: Direct global contract manufacturers and system integrators on technical test coverage, power and thermal validation, and yield optimization to meet strict schedule, cost, and quality targets.

• Harden Hardware Infrastructure Readiness: Proactively identify architectural bottlenecks, signal integrity constraints, and supply chain dependencies early in the lifecycle, establishing data-driven recovery plans that protect program timelines.

• Synthesize Technical Trade-Offs: Translate complex server architecture, electrical trade-offs, and program health metrics into clear actionable insights for engineering leadership to drive rapid decision-making in fast-paced environments.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Storage & Server Hardware Engineering Mastery: Deep technical grounding in enterprise SSDs, NAND flash, NVMe/PCIe protocols, and L10/L11 server platform integration with hands-on experience troubleshooting board-level, electrical, and signal integrity issues.

• End-to-End NPI Program Ownership: Proven track record leading complex hardware programs through design qualification, hardware debug, and volume production ramp within agile and waterfall execution frameworks.

• Strategic Vendor & ODM Governance: Expertise driving contract manufacturers, system integrators, and component suppliers on technical test plan auditing, thermal/power validation, and manufacturing yield improvement.

• Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence and align multidisciplinary hardware, electrical, firmware, and supply chain engineering teams through technical authority, clear communication, and structured risk mitigation.

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Pure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

title: QA Engineer
description:
OUR MISSION:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.

OUR VISION:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.

THE ROLE:

At Sunrise Robotics, the QA Engineer role validates the software that runs our robotic cells and helps it move from alpha to production quickly, safely, and with clear evidence.

This is not a “click around the UI” QA role. Our product is a physical robotic cell: two robot arms, cameras, safety systems, edge compute, perception, motion, behavior trees, deployment tooling, and a customer-facing interface all working together in the real world.

Your job is to help define and enforce the internal R&D definition of done for software running on robotic cells, then make the handover to deploy teams clear and low-friction. That means defining what needs to be tested, coordinating the right engineers, making test evidence visible, and making sure a robotic cell is genuinely ready for the next stage, not just passing a few isolated checks.

Early on, you’ll learn how our system works and help run the alpha-to-production validation process. Over time, we expect you to define the coding standards, acceptance criteria, quality gates, test matrices, and process automation that let every team contribute software that meets the same bar.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Validate the full robotic system, not just individual software components or UI flows.

- Help move new software from alpha to production within days, not weeks.

- Define clear test plans for features running on real robotic cells.

- Define acceptance criteria for software deployed to cells in alpha, beta and other stages.

- Help shape coding standards and release-readiness expectations for cell software.

- Coordinate engineers across software, robotics, perception, simulation, deployment, and product.

- Make sure test results, risks, blockers, and open issues are documented and communicated clearly.

- Help define what quality gates mean for different parts of the system.

- Help design and implement CI pipelines, automated checks, and process automation around validation, in collaboration with engineering.

- Reduce handover friction between teams building software and deploy teams receiving software releases.

- Improve the QA process as Sunrise scales to a larger fleet.

- Work with simulations, R&D cells, and hardware-in-the-loop validation where useful.

- Ensure robotic-cell testing follows our safety policies and operational rules.

- Build practical quality gates that help us move faster without lowering the bar.

WHAT THIS IS NOT:

- It is not manual UI testing.

- It is not factory acceptance testing ownership.

- It is not supplier or hardware quality ownership.

- It is not a role for someone who only wants perfectly defined test cases handed to them.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

- Strong experience in QA, test engineering, systems validation, or software quality.

- Ability to think in systems: software, hardware, data, operators, edge cases, and failure modes.

- Experience creating test plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, or validation processes.

- Experience working with CI pipelines, automated checks, or software release processes.

title: Technical Analyst
description:
We are Skyward.
That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology. We are a people-centered business with a desire to serve others. We are diverse and unified; creative and collaborative; a collection of complementary, not competing talents. And though on the surface we remain relaxed, beneath, a torrent of energy links us to our civic tech mission.
We stand by our values, and we won’t compromise on any of them.

Integrity: We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors.

Compassionate: If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally.

Inquisitive: We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions.

Unconventional: For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two.

Authentic: Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand.
Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.
We need a Technical Analyst.
Do you light up when a clunky workflow turns into something people actually enjoy using? Are you the type who can translate "it's kind of broken, can you fix it?" into working code, clean documentation, and a genuinely better system? If you love untangling messy processes, coaching users through the "aha" moment, and keeping software running smoother than a perfectly optimized query, we should talk.

Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.

Let's go Skyward together.

What you'll do:

• Join a team supporting the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), helping researchers figure out how to improve care and cut costs for some of the most vulnerable Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries. Real impact, not just busywork.

• Put your coding brain and your people brain to work together, building sharper user training documentation, stress-testing software before it ever reaches a user, and dreaming up smarter system configurations.

• Write, test, and maintain code in Python, R, and SQL, keeping it clean enough that future-you (or a teammate) never has to send a strongly worded Slack message.

• Get comfortable pairing with approved AI tools to fine-tune documentation and cook up fresh example programs. Think of it as your own coding sous-chef.

• Be the go-to Tier 2 support hero for our web-based analytical tools. You know, the person people count on when “it's just not working” needs an actual answer.

• Team up with fellow IT pros - project managers, system architects, database administrators, business analysts, and quality assurance teams - to get projects across the finish line looking like one cohesive, well-oiled machine.

• Help train end-users on new applications and features, guiding them through the bumpy parts of any system transition.

• Star in the occasional customer-facing webinar, bringing the content and the charisma.

What we'd like you to have:

• A bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, data science, or something adjacent that proves you speak “tech.”

• 2+ years working with software applications in a corporate environment. You've been in the trenches and lived to tell about it.

title: Government Affairs Lead
description:

Somethings is building the first social wellness platform for teens - a place where a teen can form a real relationship with a mentor who gets them, sticks with them, and helps them get better.
25 Million teens in the U.S. are struggling with their mental health. Every one of the thousands of teens who download Somethings is struggling. Our job is to make sure they don’t just show up - they stay, connect with real humans who care deeply about them, and get the support that they need to thrive.
We’re backed by General Catalyst and world-class healthcare + consumer investors, and we’re growing like crazy - in 2025 we grew 1100%, raised our $15M Series A, and are on track to 5x in 2026.
If you want to be a part of the generationally defining company in mental health, welcome home.
Role Overview
We're looking for a Government Affairs Lead to lead Somethings into its next chapter of national expansion.
This is a builder role, not a traditional government affairs position. We are not looking for a passive lobbyist or a policy memo specialist. We are looking for someone who understands state government as a living system-where policy, people, budgets, and timing intersect-and who knows how to move that system forward.
Your north star is ambitious and concrete: expand Somethings into new states by building early relationships, shaping policy and program design, and converting those opportunities into meaningful Medicaid and state partnerships. You will be responsible for creating access before RFPs exist, helping states understand how Somethings fits into their priorities, and guiding opportunities from first conversation through procurement and contracting.
This role sits at the intersection of policy, relationships, and execution. You need to be comfortable discussing Medicaid strategy with a state director in the morning, aligning internal clinical and product teams in the afternoon, and traveling to a state capital or conference the next day to continue building trust.
Travel is not incidental to this role-it is core to it. Building real relationships with state leaders requires showing up, and you should expect to spend a significant portion of your time in person with agency leadership, partners, and stakeholders across the country.
Note: We expect this role to be 50-75% travel.
You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and be embedded within the Sales squadron, while working closely with Clinical Operations, Product, and Operations. You will have significant autonomy, strong executive support, and a front-row seat to shaping how youth mental health care is delivered at a systems level.
Who You Are
You bring deep experience in Medicaid, behavioral health policy, or state government-whether from inside a state agency, a health plan, a health-tech company, or a policy organization that works closely with states. You understand how decisions are really made, including the informal dynamics that sit alongside formal processes.
You have owned end-to-end procurement processes, either within a state agency or from the vendor side, spanning budgeting through contracting.
You are a relationship builder with high emotional intelligence, able to earn trust quickly and communicate in a way that resonates with both the head and the heart. At the same time, you have a strong internal motor. You are someone who creates momentum, opens doors, and takes ownership of outcomes.
You thrive in ambiguity and high-ownership environments. You are motivated by mission, not as a slogan, but as a personal conviction. You want your work to matter, and you want to see its impact on real people’s lives.
What you’ll do
1. New State and City Expansion and Procurement

• Identify and advance new state and city opportunities aligned with Something’s growth strategy

• Build relationships with legislators, agencies, and budget offices to introduce and fund Something’s model

• Advance Rural Health Transformation (RHT) initiatives to expand

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. ABOUT THE JOB

As a Production Test Technician, you will play a critical role in ensuring our optical systems meet stringent quality standards before shipment to customers. In this position, you’ll be responsible for testing optical equipment, running validation and system-level testing, and troubleshooting complex issues. A successful candidate will have a strong background in both production and R&D environments, with the ability to collaborate effectively across interdisciplinary teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Perform testing of optical equipment according to procedures and specifications.

• Run validation and system-level testing to ensure optimal performance.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues with optical systems during testing, identifying problems in electrical systems and the associated programs.

• Follow detailed test work instructions and document results accurately in the system.

• Utilize MATLAB for data collection, coding, and analysis to support testing activities.

• Maintain test equipment and tools, ensuring they are calibrated and functioning correctly.

• Participate in root cause analysis of product failures, providing input based on testing experiences.

• Work autonomously while closely collaborating with the test engineering team to identify and report opportunities for improving testing processes and efficiencies.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Associates degree in Physics, Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience. 

• 3+ years of relevant industry experience in production or R&D testing

• Experience with cryogenics and vacuum systems in a testing environment.

• Proficiency in MATLAB for data acquisition, processing, and coding.

• Strong troubleshooting skills for non-conforming hardware and software, with the ability to identify electrical issues and program failures.

• Experience working with interdisciplinary teams in fast-paced settings.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of infrared systems or optical systems including performance requirements and verification methodologies.

• Familiarity with test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, thermal chambers, and data acquisition sensors.

• Understanding of computer hardware communication protocols (USB, Ethernet, RS232, etc.).

title: Freelance Social Media Video Host - TikTok (Contract)
description:
On-Camera Host for TikTok Videos (Contract)

We’re expanding our short-form video presence across TikTok and other platforms, and we’re looking for **confident, engaging on-camera hosts** to bring our educational content to life. If you love being on camera, can explain things clearly, and connect naturally with an audience, this role is for you. You’ll record short, informative, and relatable videos designed to help learners make smarter education decisions. This is a remote, contract role with flexible scheduling. All work is paid per video.

What You’ll Do

• Record ~1-minute short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts style) that explain educational tips, walk through practice problems, or provide career information.

• Deliver practice problems and/or talking points naturally and authentically (no editing required)

• Present with energy, clarity, and personality to keep viewers engaged.

• Demonstrate educational concepts using a dry-erase board or written solutions (dry-erase board and printer are required).

Your job: bring the content to life with your on-screen presence and confidence.

Required Skills:

• 2+ years of on-camera experience (TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or similar).

• Clear, confident, and friendly on-screen delivery .

• Ability to make educational or informational content feel fast-paced and engaging .

• Access to a smartphone or camera, microphone, and good lighting for recording.

• Comfort with visual teaching methods , such as writing and solving problems on a dry-erase board or using pen-and-paper demonstrations, with clear and readable handwriting.

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience creating content for adult or nontraditional learners.

• A background in education, advising, or communication .

• Familiarity with short-form content pacing, hooks, and trends.

• Experience using visual aids in your content with clear, legible handwriting.

How to Apply

• Submit your application with your resume and a link to a sample video.

• Provide a link to a sample video (max 2 minutes). The video should feature you on camera presenting this short script and displaying the mathematical problem and solution on a dry-erase board or a piece of paper (you don't have to write as you speak - it can be pre-written - but it needs to be in your own handwriting).

“Welcome to Study.com 's TikTok channel! I’m [your name], and I’m here to help you earn your degree faster, smarter, and for less money. Let me show you how 1 hour a day x $6,000 in savings = a bachelor's degree in 2 years! Thanks for joining me! If you find this helpful, hit that like button and subscribe for more tips from Degree Hacked.”

We’ll be evaluating:

• Your on-screen confidence and clarity

• Audio and video quality

• Authenticity and connection with the viewer

Applications without this sample video will not be considered.

What We Offer:

•
Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.

•
Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.

•
Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.

•
Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

• Complete the application and submit with your resume.

• Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.

• Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.

• The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

工作职责

线索挖掘与整理（Leads Generation）
利用多种渠道（官网注册、活动名单、线上表单、第三方平台等）挖掘潜在客户线索，并进行结构化整理与分类。

AI 驱动的线索识别与评分
熟练使用和不断优化内部及外部的 AI 工具（如：线索评分模型、意向识别模型、自动标签工具等），提升线索识别与筛选效率。
与数据/产品/运营团队合作，基于业务逻辑不断提出对 线索评分模型 与 客户画像标签 的优化建议。
持续追踪各类 AI 工具的使用效果，通过数据分析不断迭代线索获取和筛选策略。

AI 辅助的触达与培育
使用 AI 辅助写作工具 批量生成并个性化优化触达话术（邮件模版、短信/IM 文案、话术脚本等），提升打开率与回复率。
设计并执行基于 AI 的自动化触达与培育流程（例如：不同意向等级客户的分层触达节奏与内容），提高线索激活率。
通过 A/B Test 和数据复盘，持续优化 AI 生成内容的转化表现。

数据分析与流程优化
定期输出线索漏斗数据分析（线索获取 → 触达 → 激活 → 转化），识别关键瓶颈并提出改进方案。
与销售、市场、运营等团队跨部门协作，打通线索流转流程，提升整体线索生命周期管理效率。
关注行业最佳实践与 AI 在市场/销售领域的应用趋势，并转化为可落地的优化动作。

知识沉淀与团队赋能
建立并持续维护线索获取与 AI 工具使用的 SOP / Playbook。
为销售与营销团队提供关于 AI 工具使用、线索跟进策略等方面的培训与支持。

任职要求

教育与经验
本科及以上学历，专业不限，市场营销、经济、统计、数学、计算机等相关专业优先。
1-3 年及以上 销售运营 / 市场运营 / 线索运营 / 数据运营 相关工作经验，有 B2B、SaaS、金融科技行业经验者优先。
有使用 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT、Claude、Midjourney 等）辅助工作经验者优先；有参与过模型应用/智能评分项目者加分。

技能要求
对 AI 在业务场景中的应用 有明确兴趣和基本理解，愿意持续学习并实践最新工具和方法。
熟练使用 Excel/Google Sheets 进行数据整理和基础分析，有 SQL 经验更佳。
具备良好的逻辑思维与数据敏感度，能够从数据中发现问题和机会，并转化为可执行策略。
具备良好的沟通协作能力，能与销售、市场、产品、数据等多团队高效对接。

强烈的结果导向与自驱力，关注线索质量与转化效果，而不仅仅是线索数量。
对新工具、新方法保持好奇，乐于在业务场景中探索 AI 的应用边界。
抗压能力强，具备良好的时间管理与项目推动能力。

我们能提供什么
深度参与一家高速发展全球化金融科技公司的 增长引擎 搭建，有机会直接影响业务增长指标。

title: Logistics Coordinator (D)
description:
Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.
Our mission is to be the most reliable company by offering and maintaining consistently high-quality services.
We achieve the mission by fostering long-term relationships with customers, employees, and vendors. Personal attention, timely communication, and respect for all people are the basis of our business philosophy!
We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator, whoefficiently builds loads in client’s transportation management systems, schedules pickups and deliveries through the designated appointment platforms, and continuously applies and improves the standard operating procedures (SOPs) provided for each account. The role is metrics-driven, with a daily production target and a clear mandate to identify and pursue automation opportunities that increase throughput while maintaining accuracy.
Responsibilities :

• Build 40-50 truckload (TL) loads per day, entering shipment information accurately into Echo’s systems.

• Build loads using Optimizer and Accelerator, and build through Vooma where applicable per the account SOP.

• Schedule and reschedule pickup and delivery appointments through BiggerPicture.

• Follow the account-specific SOPs provided for each assigned account, ensuring loads are built and scheduled to customer requirements.

• Progressively identify and pursue automation opportunities within the SOPs to increase production and reduce manual effort.

• Validate shipment details (locations, dates, references, commodity, and special instructions) before releasing loads.

• Add notes and documentation to the relevant systems to provide full visibility of the load’s build and scheduling history.

• Communicate with shippers, receivers, and internal teams to confirm or correct appointment details when required.

• Answer and action emails related to building and scheduling in a timely manner.

• Partner with sales pods and operations to remove building and scheduling tasks from their workflows entirely.

• Escalate exceptions, blockers, and recurring issues to the appropriate Echo managers and team leads.

Requirements

• Working knowledge of Optimizer and Accelerator for load building.

• Ability to schedule appointments through BiggerPicture and build through Vooma where applicable.

• Comfortable working with current technology and competent in Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook) and Google Sheets, with strong internet navigation skills and a minimum 20 words-per-minute typing average.

• Aptitude for identifying process-automation opportunities and applying SOP improvements.

• Team-player attitude, both within the department and partnering with employees across the organization.

• Strong multitasking and organizational skills.

• Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Attention to detail is paramount.

• Time management, problem-solving, motivation, flexibility, adaptability, and proactiveness.

• Working schedule: Monday - Friday 07:30-16:30 CST
Start date - Oct 19th

• Competitive Salary in USD

• Remote or office mode of work

• 10+ business days of paid time off

• English courses

• Equipment provided

About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate -we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人 ：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人 ：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター ：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人 ：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

title: Go To Market Strategy Hospitals (x/f/m)
description:

Doctolib sucht Dich ab sofort als Praktikant:in im Bereich Go To Market Strategy Hospitals für unseren Standort in Berlin . Als Praktikant:in wirst Du dabei Teil unseres deutschen Strategie Teams für den Bereich Krankenhäuser & Großkunden. Dieses Team hat die Aufgabe, Wachstumspotenziale im Krankenhaussektor zu identifizieren, strategische Geschäftspläne zu definieren und unsere Produktstrategie im Krankenhaussegment weiterzuentwickeln, um die Marktdurchdringung zu maximieren.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Praktikant:in unterstützt Du uns dabei in folgenden Aufgabenbereichen: 

• Du unterstützt strategische Initiativen, indem Du Eigenverantwortung für kleinere Projekte oder Projektströme übernimmst

• Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Produktstrategie im Krankenhaussegment, z.B. indem Du Produktlaunches begleitest, Kundenfeedback strukturierst und zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots beiträgst

• Du bereitest Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Führungskräfte vor und sammelst Feedback vom Hospital Sales & Customer Success Team in ganz Deutschland, um unser Verständnis für unsere Krankenhauskunden zu verbessern

• Du führst Datenanalysen durch, um die Vertriebs- und Marketingleistung als auch die Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen

• Du setzt Dich mit der Digitalisierung der deutschen Krankenhäuser auseinander und analysierst relevante regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen (u.a. KHZG, KHAG), um deren Auswirkungen auf unsere Strategie und unser Produktangebot zu bewerten

Während Deiner Tätigkeit bei uns wirst Du:

• Umfassende Einblicke in die Digitalisierung des Gesundheitswesens im Bereich Krankenhäuser erhalten

• Einblicke an der Schnittstelle zwischen Strategie und Produktentwicklung gewinnen und verstehen, wie Kundenbedürfnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen einfließen

• Dir praktische Kenntnisse im Bereich Projektmanagement mit diversen internen Stakeholdern in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld aneignen

• Deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten sowohl im direkten Austausch als auch im Erstellen von Präsentationen und Reportings ausbauen

Dein Profil

title: Brand Data Production Manager (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters - keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your role

As Brand Data Production Manager, you are the driving force behind Statista’s brand-related data portfolio. You own the brand data Type as a data product, with decision-making authority over what brand data to produce, develop, maintain, or retire, set priorities and quality bar that guide the teams who build and run the data pipelines.

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of brand data domains- including brand market shares, consumer awareness, brand perception, and loyalty metrics- defining the strategic direction, target users, and value proposition and serving as the central point of contact for what brand data should cover and why.

- Translate market trends, customer needs and use cases into clear coverage priorities and requirements, turning signals from Revenue, Quality, platform and API usage, customer feedback, and industry developments into a prioritized brand data roadmap.

- Identify data coverage gaps and define pragmatic solutions evaluating potential data sources, proxy data strategies, and methodology trade-offs to close critical gaps, weighing relevance against feasibility in collaboration with production teams.

- Define and track business-facing KPIs such as coverage of priority brands, data quality, and customer impact; establish and maintain quality gates, data governance standards, and escalation processes across the production pipeline, working with the Quality team to drive continuous improvement.

- Review and challenge trade-offs proposed by production and engineering teams (e.g. coverage vs. speed, automation vs. accuracy) from a relevance and customer-value perspective, while production line owners retain responsibility for how data is produced.

- Coordinate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Content, Product, and commercial stakeholders to resolve dependencies and keep priorities aligned across the organization.

Your Profile

- Strong background in data product management, data operations, market/brand strategy, or business analytics, with the judgment to decide what data matters most and why and a track record of owning and driving a data domain or product area. Degree in a related field and/or equivalent practical experience.

- Solid understanding of data concepts and statistical reasoning, paired with a strong customer-focused business mindset and an understanding of how data creates value for users.

- Comfortable setting direction while depending on others for execution; you lead through clarity, prioritization, and evidence rather than direct control of delivery.

- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, experienced in translating complex business needs into actionable specifications for technical teams and briefing production teams around clear, well-justified priorities. Clear, confident communicator in English who excels at data storytelling and explains complex topics clearly.

- A structured, pragmatic, and curious way of working, with an ownership mindset and the ability to stay calm and decisive under pressure.

- Proficiency in Excel required; SQL and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and project tools (Jira, Confluence)

title: Structured Finance, Lead
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE STRATEGIC FINANCE TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Raise capital at the scale of a sovereign, not a startup. Powering 100 GW will take hundreds of billions of dollars in debt and equity, a capital program that rivals a national infrastructure budget. You won't run a financing process; you'll assemble one of the largest pools of private capital in the industry.

- Invent the instruments, don't pull them off the shelf. AI infrastructure is too new for the playbook to exist: credit support backed by equity warrants, hyperscaler-guaranteed leases, project finance underwritten against power and chips. You won't apply standard structures; you'll create the ones the rest of the market ends up copying. Few finance teams sit where energy markets, GPU supply, land control, and credit all converge.

- Close at the speed of the build, not the speed of finance. Capital has to land in lockstep with gigawatts coming online: multiple landmark transactions running at once, on timelines most banks would call impossible. You'll redefine how fast serious capital can move.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own financing execution across high-yield bond issuances, senior secured term loans, and equipment and project finance facilities, driving term sheet negotiation through close.

- Structure, negotiate, and document credit support: guarantees, credit wraps, off-take agreements, and investment-grade backstops, and understand how each affects debt sizing and covenant mechanics.

- Build and own transaction models: debt sizing, DSCR waterfalls, restricted payment mechanics, levered and unlevered returns, multi-scenario sensitivities. Be the team's check on model integrity across live deals.

- Design and stress-test capital structures across HoldCo/OpCo/PropCo, cross-collateralization, cross-default, and intercreditor arrangements, and work with legal to turn structure into documentation.

- Manage external counsel, financial advisors, and counterparty working groups, tracking open issues and pushing resolutions on deal timelines.

- Own investor and lender materials: investment memos, lender presentations, bond offering documents, and internal approval packages.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

As we expand, you will be responsible for building security processes from scratch, ensuring unimpeachable information security compliance across the regulated markets, and leading a distributed remote team.

InfoSecurity Strategy & Governance:

Process Management:

• Language: Fluent English with excellent communication and reporting skills; Ukrainian or Russian will be an advantage.

• Location: Must be physically located and legally authorized to work remotely within Europe.

Preferred (Nice-to-Haves)

The ChatGPT infrastructure team is responsible for ensuring that our products can serve rapidly growing demand with the performance, reliability, and quality our users expect.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead the operating system for Chat capacity and model deployment. You will connect demand forecasting and capacity allocation with model readiness, rollout planning, launch coordination, and post-deployment learning. You will also own mode deployment beyond capacity by working with cross functional teams across research, post-training, inference and product to own mainline model deployment.

You will bring structure to constrained-capacity decisions, improve the tooling and mechanisms teams use to prioritize demand, and help new models reach users safely and efficiently. - Have built operating mechanisms or tooling that replaced fragmented, manual workflows with scalable systems and clear ownership.

- Use metrics to guide decisions, identify bottlenecks, and demonstrate measurable improvements in throughput, predictability, or reliability.
